title: F1 Predict — Race Prediction Game
short_description: Predict F1 race results. Compete in private leagues with friends.
full_description:
F1 Predict lets you compete with friends by predicting the top 10 drivers in every Formula 1 race.

Create or join private leagues, lock in your driver order before qualifying, and watch your score update live as the race unfolds.

★ FEATURES ★

• Predict the top-10 finishing order for every Grand Prix and Sprint race
• Live race dashboard — compare your picks to real-time driver positions
• Private leagues — invite friends and track standings all season long
• Bonus bets — predict fastest lap, safety car count, and DNFs for extra points
• Push notifications when predictions lock and race results are published
• Apple and Google sign-in supported

★ HOW TO PLAY ★

1. Sign up and create or join a league with a unique invite code
2. Before qualifying, rank your predicted top-10 drivers
3. Lock in your bonus bets
4. Watch the race — your live dashboard updates in real time
5. Earn points based on prediction accuracy and climb the leaderboard

Free to play. No real-money gambling.
